title: Comparison of four new devices for measuring kiwifruit firmness
venue: New Zealand Journal of Crop and Horticultural Science
relevance_note: Kiwifruit: three nondestructive firmness devices were used to test the same fruit repeatedly as they softened in coolstorage. Device comparison only; no classifier built on change from the fruit's own baseline.

title: Statistical Modeling of Tomato Firmness Evolution During Postharvest Storage
relevance_note: Tomato: repeated nondestructive firmness of individual fruit over two harvests; mixed models separate within-fruit, between-fruit and between-cultivar variance. Shows that measurements of the same fruit are correlated over time. Not a classification study.

title: Tomato cultivar grouping based on firmness change, shelf life and variance during postharvest storage
relevance_note: Tomato cultivars grouped by firmness change, shelf life and variance during storage. Title suggests per-fruit change modelling; content not verified.

title: Postharvest firmness changes as measured by acoustic and low-mass impact devices: a comparison of techniques
relevance_note: Tracks postharvest firmness change with acoustic and low-mass impact devices. Content not verified.

title: Monitoring of firmness evolution of peaches during storage by combining acoustic and impact methods
relevance_note: Peaches monitored during storage with acoustic and impact tests, plus continuous and classification models. The abstract does not say whether each fruit's own earlier value was used.

title: ACOUSTIC TESTING OF AVOCADO FOR FRUIT RIPENESS EVALUATION
relevance_note: Avocado acoustic firmness index and damping followed during storage; proposes building a ripening curve by biological age. Early per-fruit trajectory idea, no classifier.

title: Firmness evaluation of postharvest pear fruit during storage based on a vibration experiment technique using a dielectric elastomer actuator
relevance_note: La France pear: resonance firmness index (f^2 m^(2/3)) tracked per fruit during storage, each fruit's trend fitted by nonlinear least squares. Uses per-fruit trajectories but not as a reference for classification.

title: Application of vibration response technique for the firmness evaluation of pear fruit during storage
venue: Journal of Food Science and Technology
relevance_note: Pear laser-Doppler vibration response during storage used for ripeness prediction and firmness modelling.

title: Firmness measurement of kiwifruit using a self-designed device based on acoustic vibration technology
relevance_note: Kiwifruit acoustic-vibration firmness device. Content not verified.

title: MELON RIPENESS MONITORING BY A PORTABLE FIRMNESS TESTER
relevance_note: Portable acoustic transmission-velocity tester; the abstract says it can monitor ripening changes in melons.

title: Monitoring of the Elasticity Index of Melon Fruit in a Greenhouse
venue: Journal of the Japanese Society for Horticultural Science
relevance_note: Melon elasticity index monitored repeatedly on the plant; within-day changes were not due to ambient temperature.

title: Effects of Ripening Stage, Temperature, and Film Wrapping on the Elasticity Index as Determined by a Nondestructive Resonance Vibration Method and Fruit Quality in ‘Irwin’ Mango
relevance_note: Mango elasticity index falls with ripening and depends on storage temperature and film wrapping. Relevant to temperature and water-loss confounds between visits.

title: ACOUSTIC MEASUREMENT OF AVOCADO FIRMNESS DURING LOW TEMPERATURE STORAGE: EFFECT OF STORAGE TEMPERATURE
relevance_note: Effect of storage temperature on acoustic avocado firmness. Content not verified; cited as a temperature-confound source only.

title: Mango Firmness Modeling as Affected by Transport and Ethylene Treatments
relevance_note: Mango: acoustic stiffness of individual fruit measured repeatedly; kinetic firmness model fitted across batches from several origins. Close in data structure (per-fruit repeats, several batches) but kinetic modelling, not a classifier.

title: Non-destructive determination of the optimum eating ripeness of pears and their texture measurements using acoustical vibration techniques
relevance_note: Taniwaki et al., optimum eating ripeness of pears from acoustic vibration. Possibly uses per-fruit EI change; content NOT verified. Get the full text before citing as a precedent.

title: Determination of optimum ripeness for edibility of postharvest melons using nondestructive vibration
relevance_note: Taniwaki et al., optimum ripeness of melons from nondestructive vibration. Content not verified.

title: Measurement of ripening speed and determination of the optimum ripeness of melons by a nondestructive acoustic vibration method
relevance_note: Taniwaki et al., 'ripening speed' and optimum ripeness of melons by acoustic vibration. Title implies a per-fruit rate of EI change, which would be the closest acoustic precedent. NOT verified; full text required.

title: Evaluation of Flesh Texture and Prediction of Optimum Ripeness in ‘Fuyu’ Persimmon after Harvest
relevance_note: Fuyu persimmon (Japanese abstract): prediction equations for the start and end of the eating window from the elasticity index at harvest day 0 (Y0); errors 0.5-1.3 d (start) and 0.7-3.5 d (end). The fruit's own intake acoustic value is used as the predictor. Closest acoustic precedent found.

title: Acoustic Probing for Estimating the Storage Time and Firmness of Tomatoes and Mandarin Oranges
relevance_note: Acoustic probing of tomatoes and mandarins over 35-60 days to regress storage time and firmness. Shows that acoustic signals encode elapsed storage time (time-shortcut risk). CV grouping not stated in the abstract. DataCite DOI, verified via OpenAlex.

title: Addressing potential sources of variation in several non-destructive techniques for measuring firmness in apples
relevance_note: Sources of variation in acoustic and impact firmness of apples; acoustic firmness showed an unexpected trend with turgidity (dehydration). Pitfall for comparing visits.

title: Improved understanding and prediction of pear fruit firmness with variation partitioning and sequential multi-block modelling
relevance_note: Pear: acoustic firmness responds differently to dehydration and to ripening. Water loss between visits changes acoustic stiffness independently of ripening.

title: Non‐destructive firmness assessment of ‘SunGold’ kiwifruit a three‐year study
venue: New Zealand Journal of Crop and Horticultural Science
relevance_note: SunGold kiwifruit across three seasons: nondestructive firmness works within a season but degrades for a season outside the training data. Precedent for between-batch/season shift in acoustic firmness.

title: Biological Variation in Ripening of Nectarines
venue: Journal of Fruit and Ornamental Plant Research
relevance_note: Nectarines: individual-fruit biological shift factor in nonlinear mixed-effects models absorbs differences in developmental stage between fruit. A statistical within-fruit offset concept.

title: Maturity assessment at harvest and prediction of softening in an early and late season melting peach
relevance_note: Peach: I_AD measured at harvest sets each fruit's biological shift factor and predicts its firmness decay during shelf life. The fruit's own harvest measurement is the reference.

title: The impact of biological variation on postharvest behaviour of tomato fruit
relevance_note: Tomato colour: probabilistic kinetics with biological age as a per-fruit random variable.

title: Towards flexible management of postharvest variation in fruit firmness of three apple cultivars
relevance_note: Apple: fruit-to-fruit variability modelled with initial firmness and rate constants as random parameters. Initial value as a per-fruit state.

title: Optical properties, ethylene production and softening in mango fruit
relevance_note: Mango TRS: variability attributed to biological age; each fruit measured on one day only (cross-sectional), so no within-fruit reference.

title: Predicting the ripening time of ‘Hass’ and ‘Shepard’ avocado fruit by hyperspectral imaging
relevance_note: Avocado: hyperspectral images of 476 unripe fruit at intake predict days until each fruit ripens (PLSR/DCNN). An intake-only predictor: comparator for 'baseline alone'.

title: Predictions of fruit shelf life and quality after ripening: Are quality traits measured at harvest reliable indicators?
relevance_note: Mango (92 fruit; several harvests, years and orchards): weak relationships between quality traits at harvest and after ripening; NIRS at harvest tested for predicting shelf life. A caution that intake measurements may carry little endpoint information. Abstract truncated.

title: Non-destructive follow-up of ‘Jintao’ kiwifruit ripening through VIS-NIR spectroscopy – individual vs. average calibration model’s predictions
relevance_note: Kiwifruit followed over 13 weeks with Vis-NIRS; compares individual-fruit predictions with averaged ones. Longitudinal per-fruit follow-up but no baseline-referenced classifier.

title: Nondestructive Apple Ripening Stage Determination Using the Delta Absorbance Meter at Harvest and after Storage
relevance_note: Apple I_AD at harvest and after storage over two seasons; cultivar thresholds. Repeated index, threshold-based.

title: Handling batch-to-batch variability in portable spectroscopy of fresh fruit with minimal parameter adjustment
relevance_note: NIR models for fresh fruit fail on new batches; semi-supervised parameter-free calibration enhancement updates the model per batch. Batch-level comparator, not fruit-level.

title: Fully Convolutional Siamese Networks for Change Detection
venue: 2018 25th IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
relevance_note: Fully convolutional Siamese networks for change detection on co-registered image pairs; the standard reference for Siamese change detection (concatenation vs difference fusion).

title: Deep Siamese Networks Based Change Detection with Remote Sensing Images
relevance_note: Deep Siamese segmentation network for change detection in remote sensing.

title: FHNet: Frequency-Aware Hyperbolic Siamese Network for Agricultural Change Detection
relevance_note: FHNet: Siamese network for agricultural (crop-field) change detection on bi-temporal images. Agricultural but field-scale remote sensing, not per-fruit sensing.

title: Siamese neural networks for continuous disease severity evaluation and change detection in medical imaging
relevance_note: Siamese CNN scores disease severity against reference images and change between longitudinal visits (ROP, knee OA). Established paired-visit Siamese design.

title: Symmetric Siamese Networks for Longitudinal Chest Radiograph Change Detection: A Leakage-Controlled Study on MIMIC-CXR
relevance_note: Full text read: Siamese DenseNet fuses [f_first; f_last; f_last - f_first]; matched baseline feeds the final image to both branches; matched binary tasks hold the final image fixed; patient-grouped CV; leakage-free, fold-nested encoder pretraining. The closest architectural and evaluation template.

title: Lung Nodule Malignancy Prediction From Longitudinal CT Scans With Siamese Convolutional Attention Networks
venue: IEEE Open Journal of Engineering in Medicine and Biology
relevance_note: Siamese attention CNN on longitudinal CT; adding time points improves malignancy prediction over a single time point.

title: Hyperspectral Imaging for Honey Quality Detection using Siamese Neural Networks
venue: 2021 5th International Symposium on Multidisciplinary Studies and Innovative Technologies (ISMSIT)
relevance_note: Honey hyperspectral Siamese network for similarity/one-shot verification. A food Siamese network, but for similarity, not temporal change.

title: Deep Siamese Networks for Plant Disease Detection
relevance_note: Plant disease Siamese network as a few-shot metric feature extractor. Agricultural Siamese network, not temporal change.

title: Few-Shot Cross-Bridge Damage Diagnosis from Vibration Sensor Signals via Siamese Contrastive Pretraining with Self-Calibrated Convolution
relevance_note: Bridge vibration: Siamese contrastive pretraining, then few-shot transfer to a new bridge. Cross-structure transfer of vibration embeddings.

title: Delta-radiomics features for the prediction of patient outcomes in non–small cell lung cancer
relevance_note: Delta-radiomics: change in features from pretreatment to during-treatment CT added to prognostic models. Hand-crafted delta features.

title: Delta radiomics: an updated systematic review
relevance_note: Systematic review of delta radiomics (48 studies; median RQS 25%). The delta-feature idea is mature in oncology imaging.

title: Baseline normalization choices inflate classification performance in wearable health monitoring: quantification and mitigation strategies
relevance_note: Wearables: baseline normalization that includes evaluation data inflates accuracy by 3-13 pp; normalization improves accuracy over none. Key leakage pitfall for baseline-referenced features.

title: A Novel Baseline Removal Paradigm for Subject-Independent Features in Emotion Classification Using EEG
relevance_note: EEG emotion: subtracting baseline power is the usual preprocessing; proposes an invariant baseline-removal method that beats subtraction. A subject-baseline precedent.

title: A Subject-Specific Approach to Detect Fatigue-Related Changes in Spine Motion Using Wearable Sensors
relevance_note: Wearable IMUs: a subject-specific composite index of change from a baseline set detects fatigue.

title: Cross-Tool Wear Prediction with Limited Labeled Tools: Baseline Calibration and Validation-Set-Free Model Selection
relevance_note: Preprint (not peer reviewed). Cross-tool wear prediction: initial-baseline normalization plus a relative target under leave-one-tool-out validation; a no-signal mean-curve baseline is strong. Near-identical logic to the planned design in another domain.

title: Cross-Domain Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Element Bearings Using Deep Generative Neural Networks
relevance_note: Healthy-only target fault-diagnosis domain adaptation (from the prior anchor memo). Batch/domain-level anchor, not per-unit.

title: Missing-Class-Robust Domain Adaptation by Unilateral Alignment
relevance_note: Unilateral alignment for domain adaptation when target classes are missing (fault diagnosis). Batch-level anchor comparator.

title: One-Class Drift Compensation for an Electronic Nose
relevance_note: One-class drift compensation for an e-nose (from the prior anchor memo). Batch-level anchor.

title: The use of percentage change from baseline as an outcome in a controlled trial is statistically inefficient: a simulation study
relevance_note: Simulation: ANCOVA beats change scores, and percentage change is least efficient and sensitive to variance. Argues against ratio features (f ratio, stiffness ratio) as the only baseline use.

title: The correlation between baseline score and post-intervention score, and its implications for statistical analysis
relevance_note: Change score is always correlated (usually negatively) with baseline; change scores do not remove regression to the mean, so adjust for baseline (ANCOVA).

title: Regression to the mean: what it is and how to deal with it
relevance_note: Regression to the mean in repeated data, worse with larger measurement error.

title: Cross-Device Spectrum Correction for Sustainable Acoustic Monitoring of Everyday Mechanical Equipment
venue: Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Information Technology for Social Good
relevance_note: Cross-device spectral coloration of phones/microphones can be as large as differences between condition states; calibrated spectrum correction. Device-mismatch pitfall between visits.

title: Multi-Modal Sensor Data for Durian Fruit Maturity Classification and Ripeness Assessment
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
relevance_note: The dataset under study (189 fruits, four modalities). DataCite DOI, verified via OpenAlex. Intake plus endpoint structure per project audit.

title: Durian Ripeness Classification from the Knocking Sounds Using Convolutional Neural Network
relevance_note: Durian knock CNN, 30 fruits, three ripeness classes; single-capture classification.

title: A dual-stream CNN-based ConvMixer for durian ripeness classification using magnitude and phase features from knocking sounds
relevance_note: KnockNet, 52 Monthong fruits, five-fold CV; single-capture classification.

title: A handheld acoustic sensing device with mixed-domain learning for real-time, in-field durian maturity classification
relevance_note: Handheld acoustic device, 142 fruits, two orchards, two years; inter-annual shift handled by mixed-domain (pooled) training. No per-fruit reference.

title: Development of non-destructive durian fruit maturity detection tool based on multi-variable sensor for harvest quality optimisation
relevance_note: 90 fruits, gas/thermal/acoustic; fruit-level grouped validation against repeated-measurement leakage. Scalar acoustic dB alone was weak. No within-fruit baseline.

title: Conventional MFCC and phase-difference MFCC interaction network for durian days-after-anthesis estimation
relevance_note: Orkweha 2026 COMPAG: MFCC and phase-difference MFCC network for durian days-after-anthesis estimation. 'Phase-difference' is a signal feature, not a visit difference (inferred from title). Content not verified.

title: MCAFNet: A multimodal audio-visual cross-attention fusion network for on-the-branch durian (Durio zibethinus L.) fruit maturity assessment
relevance_note: MCAFNet 2026 COMPAG: audio-visual fusion for on-branch durian maturity. Content not verified.

title: Ripeness and quality of harvested durian determined using Raman spectroscopy combined with physico-chemical and volatile characteristics
relevance_note: Raman spectroscopy of harvested durian ripeness and quality. Content not verified.

title: Model for Predicting and Classifying Durian Fruit Based on Maturity and Ripeness Using Neural Network
relevance_note: Neural-network maturity/ripeness classifier for durian (IFAC 2001).

title: Assessment of Natural Fruit Ripening and Fruit Quality of Three Elite Durian Cultivars for Overland Export
relevance_note: Natural ripening duration after harvest by cultivar (Monthong about 9 d). Destructive and sensory, no repeated sensing.

title: Durian Fruit Dehiscence—Water Status and Ethylene
relevance_note: Durian dehiscence promoted by low RH and ethylene; coatings cut weight loss by 7-14%. Husk splitting and water loss between visits are durian-specific acoustic confounds.

title: Postharvest Responses of Durian (Durio zibethinus cv. Puyat) Fruit to a Paraffin-based Wax as Surface Coating
relevance_note: Puyat durian at ambient for 12 d: weight loss, dehiscence timing and firmness changes. Mass and husk state change between intake and endpoint.
